description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class, which implements the Rust::IPlugin interface for a plugin system. It includes method declarations for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interaction with a socket server, as well as handling of plugin activation, deactivation, and message processing within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.
